blocks.text: in camera galerie , Les Rencontres du Sud and Ciné Club Afro are organizing a private screening of Ananias Léki Dago ’s documentary Je reste photographe ( I am still a photographer) , on the occasion of the exhibition Paul Kodjo: Photoromance at the Palais de Tokyo.

In Je reste photographe , Ananias Léki Dago looks back at the preservation work undertaken to save photographer Paul Kodjo’s negatives. Beyond the portrait of an artist, the film opens a reflection on the conservation of African photographic archives and the place they occupy in our collective memory.
Tuesday, October 27 8 p.m. UGC Odéon (124 bd Saint-Germain, Paris 6th) Admission is free with reservation, subject to availability. RSVP link.
The screening will be followed by a discussion with the director, moderated by journalist Samba Doucoure.
This event is organized with the support of the Ministry of Culture and Francophonie of Côte d’Ivoire.
